One sunny day, Chicken Little was sleeping under a tree when an acorn fell on her head and landed next to her. “Oh no!” she squawked as she woke up. “The sky is falling!” Un día soleado, Chicken Little dormía bajo un árbol cuando una bellota le cayó en la cabeza y aterrizó a su lado. “¡Ay, no!”, chilló al despertarse. “¡Se cae el cielo!”.
